caption: The drawing depicts a single glass pitcher with a wide, rounded base and a slightly flared mouth. The pitcher is rendered in shades of grey, suggesting a clear or colorless glass material. The upper rim of the pitcher is highlighted with a bright blue color. The body of the pitcher features a textured, diamond-patterned design in the upper section, with a series of horizontal ridges wrapping around the middle, and vertical fluting below that. The handle is attached at the top near the rim and curves downward, attaching again near the body’s widest point. The pitcher sits on a circular footed base. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, and there is a small, horizontal scale and a signature “John Takanjitso” at the lower right corner.
title: Creamer
